text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I headed to the cafeteria at 
mealtime, I spotted Inari One with a feast 
of dishes laid out across her table.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Boss, get this. Looks like the 
cafeteria switched suppliers for their 
fried tofu—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Sis, get this. Looks like the 
cafeteria switched suppliers for their 
fried tofu—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"I had some inari sushi, and lemme tell 
ya, was it delicious or what?! It was so 
mind-blowingly tasty it knocked my socks 
right off!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I went and ordered every 
single fried tofu dish on the menu! Right 
then, time to dig in!
choice_data_list:
Aren't you ordering a bit too much, no 
matter how you look at it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I guess anyone would say that 
after seeing this much food laid out. 
Still, we already ordered it, so—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, that's a great idea! The fried tofu 
ain't goin' anywhere, so let's keep it to 
eighty percent full for today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll start with the kitsune soba. 
Whoa! The fried tofu is totally soaked in 
broth!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two decided to share the fried 
tofu, preventing Inari One from 
overeating.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You got it! I'm gonna savor this new fried 
tofu!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Check this out! This thick fried tofu is 
grilled to absolute perfection! I can 
smell the savory aroma just by looking at 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Inari One ate her fill of 
deep-fried tofu dishes.
